thread:
Maya (infra-oncall): Pager alert: multiple serving pods in us-east-1 cluster reporting CUDA OOMs and container restarts. Symptoms started ~1800504300. I see correlated network errors on the IB fabric (ifconfig/ibstat). P50 latency spiking and a handful of pods flapping. Paging runtime-oncall.

PagerBot: INCIDENT CREATED • INC-2026-1472 • Sev2 • impacted: redwood-7b serving pool (us-east-1). Paging: @Sam @Maya @Jules.

Sam (runtime-oncall): On it. I see the same in logs: repeated kernel-level RDMA timeouts then container restart. Stack shows `cudaMalloc` failing right as requests pile up. Likely packet loss resulting in head-of-line replay/backpressure -> KV cache growth -> OOM.

Jules (runtime-eng): Confirmed. From the node telemetry: IB port errors (rx_err, crc) rising on top-of-rack switch for rack-r3. `ibv_devinfo` shows link flapping on hca-2.

Ravi (sre-lead): Quick customer impact check: dashboard shows error-rate for AcmeCorp (acct-4321) ~2.3% over last 10m, latency p95 doubled. No SLA breach yet but trending. Ava please notify CS and list affected customers.

Ava (acct-ops): Notifying AcmeCorp support now (brief advisory). Will escalate if they report production impact.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Short mitigation plan: 1) move serving pods off affected rack (node eviction) 2) enable TCP fallback routing for model pool 3) reduce batch size + disable prefetching to limit KV growth 4) restart RDMA stack on nodes after cordon. Executing now.

Maya (infra-oncall): I'm cordoning nodes in rack-r3. Command: ```kubectl cordon node-r3-1 && kubectl drain node-r3-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60``` Doing them one at a time.

Jules (runtime-eng): Patch to runtime config to reduce batch size rolling out: `runtime.batch_max_tokens=512 -> 256` and `cache.prefetch=false`. Pushing canary to 10% first.

MonBot: Alert suppression engaged for repeated RDMA kernel messages to reduce noise.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Canary shows immediate drop in memory growth for canary pods. CPU up slightly but stable. No OOMs in canary. Proceeding to scale rollout.

Ravi (sre-lead): Also open ticket with colo ops for IB switch (r3-tor-5) — request immediate port diagnostics and a scheduled maintenance window if hardware issue. Maya, can you collect `ethtool -S`/switch counters?

Maya (infra-oncall): Collected and uploaded to runbook: `s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-1472/ib-counters-r3-tor-5.log`. Key counters: tx_discards=320, link_retries=41, crc_errors rising.

Jules (runtime-eng): Meanwhile, enabling routing policy fallback: `policy.routing.us-east-1=prefer_tcp_on_failure` so new requests hit TCP-backed nodes. This should avoid RDMA dependency until hardware is healthy.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Note: TCP fallback increases latency ~10-20ms but prevents OOM chain reaction. Rolling to 30% initially for risk mitigation.

Ava (acct-ops): AcmeCorp says they saw intermittent 502s but are stable now after your earlier routing change. They're asking for ETA on full fix.

Ravi (sre-lead): ETA depends on hardware ops — if switch needs replacement likely 2-4h. If it's a transient flapping port/cable, could be 30-90m. Keep CS updated.

Maya (infra-oncall): Colo ops reports a bad QSFP on port 12, replacement en route. They're going to swap and monitor.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Continuing runtime mitigations: we've lowered `cache.kv_max_size` by 40% to reduce memory pressure and enabled aggressive cache eviction. Also turned on soft OOM handler to fail fast earlier and avoid catastrophic restarts.

Jules (runtime-eng): Adding temporary autoscale up for dedicated GPU pool to absorb burst while nodes drain: `dedicated_pool.us-east-1.desired=+6gpus` will give headroom.

MonBot: Incident timeline note appended to INC-2026-1472 runbook.

Ravi (sre-lead): Handoff plan in 15m: Sam will continue hotfix and runtime metrics, Maya remains infra liaison with colo, Jules will track rollout and KV behavior, I'll coordinate comms and severity. If anything degrades, escalate to Dev Leadership.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Canary -> full rollout completed for batch and cache changes. OOMs have dropped to near zero in the affected pool. Observability: p95 latency elevated but steady.

Maya (infra-oncall): Colo confirms QSFP swap complete at 1800505200. IB counters have stabilized, crc_errors back to baseline. Re-enabled RDMA routing gradually.

Jules (runtime-eng): Re-enabled RDMA for 50% of traffic to validate — no flaps, memory stable. Will continue staged rollback to normal routing over 30m.

Ava (acct-ops): AcmeCorp confirmed recovery on their side and appreciated the proactive updates. No customer-facing postmortem requested yet.

Ravi (sre-lead): Lowering severity to Sev3, but keeping incident open for verification window (1h). Action items: 1) postmortem with root-cause (QSFP + lack of TCP fallback test) 2) follow-up: add automatic early OOM mitigation in serving runtime 3) improve runbooks for IB hardware swaps. Assigning owners in runbook.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Adding brief mitigation notes to runbook + commands used. Will hand off to next oncall @Jules in 15m.

Jules (runtime-eng): Acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor the rollback and begin a lightweight load test to validate behavior.

MonBot: Incident INC-2026-1472 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Maya (infra-oncall): Ending active paging for infra. Keeping channel open for verification and postmortem.

Ravi (sre-lead): Good job team. We'll schedule the postmortem and include timeline, customer impact, mitigation steps, and follow-ups.

Sam (runtime-oncall): Handoff complete at 1800505623.

(End of thread)
